method: Read sealed public-api.jsonl and harness.json; summary checker boolean is result-only. No simulator/model replay. All consumed files verified against campaign seal. Post-state confirmation was additionally linked to its harness call-end digest and verified before first mask publication.

definitions.endpoint: strict supported full message + error move_to with consistent explicit actor; mask additionally source ref and unchanged public post XYZ
definitions.failure_signature: endpoint: kind+actor+exactXYZ; path: kind+actor+exactXYZ+public startXYZ; other adds message; comparison omits plan only for same-task paired trials
definitions.scope_limit: All actual search moves request z=20. No claim of executed cross-altitude policy, geometry inference, or dynamic map safety.

limitations: No replay, counterfactual trajectory, model selection or generalization test.
Raw logs and code support first divergence caused by shared exact endpoint exclusion; later success/cost trajectories contain downstream changes and are not independent mask effects.
No hidden geometry, target locations or checker conditions were used for policy explanations. Checker pass values copied only as final outcomes.
No evidence of cross-plan reuse in these single-plan trials; unit tests and implementation establish rejection/isolation behavior.
Public failure messages name obstacles but do not provide geometry or reliable IDs.
